scope.summary: Implement human/agent presence, leases, proposals, attribution, stale-state detection, and conflict-resolution UX for parallel Tailor authoring.
acceptance_criteria: Every visible edit/action is attributable to actor, lane, entity, base version, and receipt.
Lease contention and stale proposals offer compare, rebase, branch, or discard without silent last-writer loss.
A human plus two headless agents can work concurrently with bounded, observable, recoverable state.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-698 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.
scope.risk_if_missed: Parallel model support is unsafe if edits are invisible, unattributed, or silently overwrite one another.

surfaces: Tailor collaboration, presence, proposal, and conflict surfaces

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Tailor workspace and controls

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT is observed through the canonical command, job, or artifact owner; it must preserve correlation identifiers and must not create a second event authority.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
